_comment_bucket_roles: Two separate buckets exist for this app: (1) the OTA bucket used by CI/CD and read by clients checking for updates — name lives in ota/config/ota_config.yaml, currently 'ecan-releases'. (2) the runtime app-storage bucket used by utils/storage/get_storage_provider() for user uploads / avatars / exports — the storage_bucket/cdn/region fields below (currently 'ecan-skills'). They MUST stay separate; never point an OTA artifact upload at the runtime bucket.
_comment_removed_fields: Removed (unreferenced in production code): graphql, websocket, auth, update, website, privacy_policy, terms_of_service, support. Cloud GraphQL/WS endpoints live in apps/{intl,cn}/config/auth_config.yml -> APPSYNC.* and are read by agent/cloud_api/endpoints.py.
